name: push-notes
description: push several repos from one push-notes.yaml, each commit message a short lowercase note and nothing else, with a pane to review and edit before shipping

enforce.title: Keep commits on push notes
enforce.description: What happens when an agent runs git commit or git push in Bash: remind (let it run, then tell the agent to use push notes), block (refuse it and point the agent at push notes), or off.
